title: Some or Any
description: Choose some or any to complete everyday sentences, with a short explanation after each answer.

thumbnail.alt: A kitchen table with a few apples and an empty fruit bowl
thumbnail.prompt: A kitchen table with a few apples and an empty fruit bowl. Flat vector illustration, soft warm earthy palette (terracotta, sage green, ochre, muted blue, cream) with a small touch of muted gold, very subtle, even paper grain, simple rounded shapes, gentle soft lighting, centered composition with generous empty space around the subject, mid-tone background that works on both dark and light pages. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no real or famous people, no watermark. Full-bleed flat background color from edge to edge: no frame, no border, no round or oval vignette, no wreath, no mandala or ornament in the middle of the image.

questions.prompt: There is ___ milk in the fridge.
Are there ___ eggs in the basket?

questions.explanation: Use some in offers and requests, even though they are questions.

questions.prompt: I need ___ help with my homework, please.
questions.explanation: Use some in positive sentences, like requests for help.
